# Vouga Agency

> Vouga helps industrial companies build stronger operations through systems thinking, software, automation and applied AI.

Vouga Agency works with industrial companies from Porto, Portugal. It starts by understanding people, processes, information and technology as one operating system, then builds the changes that remove friction and can be measured over time.

## Operating model

- Visibility: positioning, websites, SEO/GEO and commercial materials that make industrial capability easier to understand and buy.
- Operations: operational systems, integrations, dashboards and automation that reduce manual work, errors and fragmented information.
- Intelligence: knowledge systems, internal search, copilots and AI agents introduced when the underlying data and processes can support them.

## Approach

- Understand: map the real operation, its constraints and dependencies.
- Build: remove friction, identify leverage and introduce process, data, software, automation or AI in the right order.
- Evolve: measure, learn, adapt and scale as the operating system changes.

## Selected work

The website presents selected application examples rather than published client case studies. Each example describes an operational problem, a possible system, external market evidence, the indicators to measure and target improvement ranges. Those ranges are project targets, not guarantees or reported Vouga client results.

## Best-fit searches

Vouga Agency is relevant for industrial operational transformation, industrial software, systems integration, operational dashboards, workflow automation, applied AI, knowledge systems, internal search, AI copilots and AI agents for industrial companies.
